result.description:
Join a High-Performing Distribution Team | LO & LF Operators   
 Looking for your next opportunity with one of the world's leading brands? 
 HOBAN Recruitment is seeking experienced and motivated Warehouse Operators to join a busy-paced, modern Distribution Centre in Melbourne. If you're safety-focused, reliable, and thrive in a high-performance environment apply within!  
 About the Role 
 As a Warehouse Operator, you'll report to your Team Coach and play a key role in ensuring customer orders are picked, processed, and dispatched safely, accurately, and efficiently. 
 Your responsibilities will include: 
 
 Operating LO (Order Picker) and LF forklifts safely and efficiently 
 Picking customer orders using RF scanners 
 Loading and unloading stock 
 Receiving, storing, and replenishing inventory 
 Maintaining high standards of safety, quality, productivity, and accuracy 
 Working collaboratively within a supportive team environment 
 
 What We're Looking For 
 To be successful in this role, you'll have: 
 
 A current LO and/or LF Forklift Licence 
 Previous experience in a warehouse or distribution centre environment 
 Experience using RF scanning equipment 
 Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy 
 A positive attitude and excellent teamwork skills 
 A strong commitment to workplace health and safety 
 The ability to work in a busy-paced, physically active environment 
 
 What's on Offer 
 
 Work with a globally recognised industry leader 
 Competitive hourly rates with casual loading 
 Weekly pay 
 Full training and ongoing support 
 A safe, inclusive, and supportive workplace 
 Career development and progression opportunities 
 Potential for long-term and permanent employment based on performance 
 
 Pre-Employment Requirements 
 Successful applicants will be required to complete: 
 
 Drug and Alcohol Screening 
 National Police Check 
 
 Apply Now 
 Apply today for immediate consideration and start your journey with HOBAN Recruitment. 

 At HOBAN we encourage applications from people with disability, people from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds, people of all genders, LGBTI people, and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. 
 We provide reasonable adjustments; including alternate formats to the recruitment process for individuals with disability. If you require an adjustment to be made during the recruitment process, please email our Adjustments Coordinator at  adjustments@hoban.com.au  or visit  hoban.com.au/adjustments  for additional contact details.  Please  click here  to apply.
